BrochureContent.Content:
Brant & Co Property Consultants are delighted to present No. 70 Millers Avenue to the market, an exceptional A-rated three-bedroom family home that has been finished and maintained to an impeccable standard throughout. Beautifully positioned within the highly sought-after Millers Glen development, this stunning home offers the perfect blend of style, comfort and modern family living.

From the moment you step inside, the quality of finish is immediately evident. A bright and welcoming entrance hall leads to a beautifully appointed living room, where a large feature bay window floods the room with natural light, creating a wonderful sense of space. Elegant herringbone flooring, contemporary décor, built-in ceiling speakers and French doors opening to the rear garden make this a superb space for relaxing or entertaining.

To the rear, the impressive open-plan kitchen and dining area has been thoughtfully designed as the heart of the home. Finished with contemporary cabinetry and quality fittings, it enjoys views over the landscaped rear garden and is complemented by a separate utility room and stylish guest WC. The kitchen also benefits from a drinking water filtration system at the sink.

Upstairs, the accommodation continues to impress with three generous bedrooms, including a luxurious principal bedroom complete with a walk-in wardrobe and a beautifully finished ensuite bathroom. A contemporary family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms, all of which are bright, spacious and immaculately presented. The property also benefits from stair access to the attic, providing excellent additional storage.

One of the standout features of this exceptional home is undoubtedly the sun-drenched south-facing rear garden. Beautifully landscaped and designed with entertaining in mind, it features a stunning timber pergola/garden room, which is included in the sale, creating the perfect outdoor retreat for relaxing, dining or entertaining family and friends throughout the year.

The current owners have also invested in a range of high-quality upgrades, including electric roof-mounted solar panels, a WiFi-enabled smart heating control system, BBQ LAN and TV cable outlets throughout the property, built-in speakers in the living room and a host of thoughtful finishes that make this home as practical as it is stylish.

No. 70 is presented in genuine turnkey condition and offers buyers the opportunity to simply move in and enjoy one of Swords' finest family homes.
Completing the ground floor is a stylish guest WC.

Upstairs, the accommodation continues to impress with three generously proportioned bedrooms, including a superb principal bedroom complete with a luxurious ensuite bathroom and a spacious walk-in wardrobe. A beautifully appointed family bathroom finished with elegant marble-effect tiling serves the remaining bedrooms, all of which are bright, spacious and beautifully presented.

Outside, the rear garden offers a private, low-maintenance space ideal for relaxing, entertaining or enjoying family time, while the attractive front aspect provides excellent kerb appeal.

Millers Glen has quickly become one of Swords' most desirable residential developments, offering a superb family-friendly setting with excellent connectivity. Residents enjoy easy access to Dublin Airport, the M1 and M50 motorways, while Dublin City Centre is easily reached via regular Dublin Bus services and the Swords Express.

The property is within easy reach of excellent schools, including Swords Educate Together, together with numerous primary and secondary schools in the surrounding area.

Shopping and leisure facilities are second to none, with Pavilions Shopping Centre, Airside Retail Park, cafés, restaurants, sports clubs, parks and a host of local amenities all just minutes away.

Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the exceptional quality and finish of this outstanding home.
